purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0215 in the gauge arena: a force on matter: a trit charge with a stand-in inertia crosses when its position counter passes a dock, reads the shaped light's shadow flux as an integer and is pushed by it: it accelerates exactly in a uniform husk field and reads the static Coulomb field to a tenth of a percent at rest, reversibly and with Gauss exact, but each crossing creates the transverse energy of the unit it drops (about 16 r times the Coulomb binding at any depth), so energy is not conserved and a released pair runs away.
